units.source: As an alternative to __TRILIUM_PH_0__hosting your own Trilium instance__TRILIUM_PH_1__, there are two services out there that provide out of the box support for Trilium.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Disclaimer__TRILIUM_PH_1__: The Trilium Notes project and maintainers are not directly affiliated with either of the projects.
PikaPods have gracefully offered us free credits for testing purposes.

units.context: Third-party cloud hosting > Cloud instance providers
Third-party cloud hosting > Cloud instance providers > PikaPods
Third-party cloud hosting > Cloud instance providers > PikaPods

units.source: In the “Available Apps” section, look for "TriliumNext__TRILIUM_PH_0__ and select “Run your own”.
units.context: Third-party cloud hosting > Cloud instance providers > PikaPods

units.source: Follow the on-screen instructions to set up your own cloud hosted instance.
units.context: Third-party cloud hosting > Cloud instance providers > PikaPods

units.source: PikaPods generally updates their Trilium instances to the latest version within a two-week interval after a new version is released.
units.context: Third-party cloud hosting > Cloud instance providers > PikaPods

units.source: Matching your version with the cloud instance__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Third-party cloud hosting > Matching your version with the cloud instance

units.source: Please note that once you set up __TRILIUM_PH_0__Synchronization__TRILIUM_PH_1__ between a cloud instance and __TRILIUM_PH_2__desktop__TRILIUM_PH_3__ clients, it's important that the version of the desktop application and the server match up.
units.context: Third-party cloud hosting > Matching your version with the cloud instance

units.source: When setting up a cloud instance, it's best to check the version of the server by accessing it via a web browser and going to the __TRILIUM_PH_0__About__TRILIUM_PH_1__ section. It's best that both the desktop and the server have the same __TRILIUM_PH_2__App version__TRILIUM_PH_3__; however it's generally OK to update the desktop to a newer version than the server if it has the same __TRILIUM_PH_4__Sync version__TRILIUM_PH_5__.
units.context: Third-party cloud hosting > Matching your version with the cloud instance

units.source: If the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Sync version__TRILIUM_PH_1__ between the server and the desktop application doesn't match, synchronization will not work.
units.context: Third-party cloud hosting > Matching your version with the cloud instance
